conditions: Local Rails production build, direct Puma HTTP delivery with build-generated gzip assets (no CDN/proxy), Chrome mobile 390x844 DPR1, simulated default Lighthouse throttling, fresh browser/storage each run. Sizes include response headers and are transfer bytes, not source/gzip estimates. HTML and total-page sizes are informational; JavaScript, CSS, image-size and request-count budgets are enforced. Rails process is warm after smoke routes; LCP/CLS are reported, not gated across heterogeneous CI hosts.
